name: With Thanks
summary: A thank-you note on a sunny desk that unfolds from its own origami envelope, then folds up and flies off
about: A handwritten-style thank-you note on a linen desk with tea, a fountain pen and eucalyptus. It flies in folded and sealed with a sticker, the sticker peels away and the four corners unfold in 3D to show the note; fold it back up and it gets sealed again, flies off with a dotted trail and comes home with a postmark. Write who it is for, your note and your name, pick the envelope paper and sticker, and share a link that opens your folded note.
how: Open the page: the folded note lands on the desk, the sticker peels off and the corners unfold one by one.
Press Fold it and send to fold the corners back in, seal it and watch it fly off and come back.
Press Open the note or the sticker itself to unfold it again; move your pointer to tilt the paper.
Tap the pen or Doodle on it to draw little hearts, stars and flowers in the margins.
In Write your own, fill in For, From and your note (or pick an idea), then choose the paper and sticker.
Copy the link or Share it; it opens with your note folded and sealed.
